title: Karthigai Deepam – Tamil Nadu, 1987

historical_context.cultural_period: Traditional Tamil Nadu during the late 1980s
historical_context.era_accuracy: Authentic 1987 Tamil lifestyle, architecture, clothing, household objects, customs and cultural traditions

SCALE_Framework.S_Subject: A traditional Tamil family celebrating Karthigai Deepam in 1987. Women wearing authentic traditional cotton sarees with simple hairstyles and jasmine flowers, men wearing white cotton veshti and angavastram, and children participating in the family celebrations. The family is surrounded by handmade clay oil lamps (agal vilakku), traditional decorations and festive household preparations.
SCALE_Framework.C_Composition: Wide cinematic establishing shot of a traditional Tamil house entrance at sunrise. Beautiful intricate white rice-flour kolam designs decorate the entrance and courtyard. Rows of handmade clay oil lamps are arranged along the entrance steps, compound walls, windowsills and rooftops. Family members gather around the courtyard. Traditional red-tiled houses and the distant silhouette of Annamalai Hill create a beautiful background. The composition captures both intimate family celebrations and the spiritual significance of the festival.
SCALE_Framework.A_Action: At sunrise on Karthigai Deepam morning in 1987, a traditional Tamil family gathers outside their home. The previous night's clay oil lamps continue to glow softly. Women prepare fresh kolams using rice flour, elders offer morning prayers, and children admire the remaining flickering lamps. Family members share joyful conversations and traditional festive moments. In the distant background, the sacred Mahadeepam on Annamalai Hill in Tiruvannamalai remains a symbolic focal point of devotion and Tamil cultural heritage.
SCALE_Framework.L_Location: Tiruvannamalai, Tamil Nadu, South India, in 1987. A traditional Tamil residential neighbourhood near the historic Annamalaiyar temple. Authentic village houses featuring red clay-tiled roofs, wooden doors, traditional pillars, open courtyards, stone pathways and narrow streets. Annamalai Hill is visible in the distance, representing the sacred location of the magnificent Karthigai Deepam Mahadeepam.
